description: This Java class 'SlotterUtil' provides utility methods for processing lists of 'Note' objects, including categorizing, time-sorting, and initial-based sectioning, for an Android application related to Nextcloud Notes.

classes.name: SlotterUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate categorized, time-sorted, and initial-sorted lists of notes for display purposes.

methods.name: fillListByCategory
methods.description: Creates a list of items grouped by category, inserting section headers when category changes.

methods.name: fillListByTime
methods.description: Creates a list of items sorted by time, inserting section headers for different time slots.

methods.name: fillListByInitials
methods.description: Creates a list of items sorted by the initials of their titles, inserting section headers for different initials.

search-terms: Time and initial sorting in notes
